a.lede: The 12V-2x6 connector nearly took out two RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation GPUs; luckily, the owner spotted the damaged cables before they melted the GPU connectors.
a.title: Nvidia RTX PRO 6000 user’s cables almost melted, even when limited to 500W

b.lede: The latest incident comes amid growing concerns over GPU theft, with experts warning that advanced Nvidia chips can command significantly higher prices abroad and could end up in black-market channels.
b.title: Six pallets of Nvidia GPUs worth $11.4 million stolen in California cargo heist
